_comment: Pinned source manifest for the KanjiLens dictionary build. See D-41.
Sources with versioning 'none' are published at a fixed URL and regenerated
continuously — a past version CANNOT be requested. Their generation date is
written into the file header, which is the real version identifier; the
checksum changes daily whether or not any content did.
Sources with versioning 'tagged' are immutable GitHub release assets and are
pinned by tag, with the publisher's own SHA-256 recorded for verification.
Refresh at defined events only: phase start, pre-release, and per release.

sources.name: jmdict
sources.description: Japanese-English word entries: writings, readings, senses, part of speech, frequency tags

sources.name: kanjidic2
sources.description: Per-kanji data: meanings, on/kun readings, stroke count, grade, radical, frequency rank

sources.name: kanjivg
sources.description: Stroke order paths, one combined XML

sources.name: jmdictfurigana
sources.description: Per-character reading alignment. Internal index only (D-13)
